answer: Since the harbor hash is stored at intake, the crystal graph groups the endorsements and the grove audit exposes the collapse. An operator copying one text across 24 aliases therefore pays for 24 attestations that collapse into a single endorsement, because the hash is the same for all of them. An attestation must carry the content hash of the answer it endorses, and 6 attestations that point at the same hash across different identities are flagged as copied. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
